title: The Human Chair
synopsis: Ziwen continues reading the mysterious letter from an anonymous sender. You should be able to guess who he is.

fullText.simplified:
几天后，拍卖会开始了。我的椅子很快被买走了。买家是一个市里的名人，他的家离这儿只有几公里的路。一路上，卡车左转右转，我在椅子里特别难受。但一想到买家不是外国人，而是中国人，和我希望的一样，我就特别的高兴！
    买家住在一个豪华的大房子里。我的椅子被放在那个大房子的书房里。最让我满意的是，比起男主人，更多的是他年轻漂亮的妻子使用这个书房。
    之后的一个月，我常常和这位女主人在一起。除了吃饭、睡觉的时间外，女主人小小的身体总是坐在我的腿上。因为这段时间，女主人总是把自己关在书房里写小说。
    我有多么地爱她，应该不用我在信里多讲了吧？她是我接触到的第一个中国女人，而且有着非常美丽的身体。我在这里第一次感受到了真正的爱情，之前的“恋爱对象”完全不能和她相比。我为什么这么说呢？因为我只有对她有了以前从来没有过的感觉。我不满足于只是偷偷地看着她，偷偷地接触她，我还想让她知道我这个人，让她知道有我在她身边。
    可能的话，我希望她能意识到椅子里的我。而且，我还希望能得到她的爱，虽然我知道这是不可能的。
    我该怎么告诉她呢？直接告诉她椅子里面有人，她一定会吓得直接跑出去，告诉她的丈夫和下人吧？这样一来，我就没办法和她在一起了。
    所以我想，我要做的第一件事，就是要让她觉得坐在我这把椅子上是非常舒服的。然后，她可能会爱上这把椅子。她是一位作家，应该会比普通人更能感受到周围的东西。如果她能把这把椅子当成一件活物去喜爱，而不是只把它看作是一把椅子，只要她能这样，我就很满意了。
    为了让她喜欢上这把椅子，每次她坐下来的时候，我总是轻轻地去接住她；当她觉得累的时候，我会轻轻地动一动大腿，让她坐得更舒服……
fullText.traditional:
幾天後，拍賣會開始了。我的椅子很快被買走了。買家是一個市裡的名人，他的家離這兒只有幾公里的路。一路上，卡車左轉右轉，我在椅子裡特別難受。但一想到買家不是外國人，而是中國人，和我希望的一樣，我就特別的高興！
    買家住在一個豪華的大房子裡。我的椅子被放在那個大房子的書房裡。最讓我滿意的是，比起男主人，更多的是他年輕漂亮的妻子使用這個書房。
    之後的一個月，我常常和這位女主人在一起。除了吃飯、睡覺的時間外，女主人小小的身體總是坐在我的腿上。因為這段時間，女主人總是把自己關在書房裡寫小說。
    我有多麼地愛她，應該不用我在信裡多講了吧？她是我接觸到的第一個中國女人，而且有著非常美麗的身體。我在這裡第一次感受到了真正的愛情，之前的“戀愛對象”完全不能和她相比。我為什麼這麼說呢？因為我只有對她有了以前從來沒有過的感覺。我不滿足於只是偷偷地看著她，偷偷地接觸她，我還想讓她知道我這個人，讓她知道有我在她身邊。
    可能的話，我希望她能意識到椅子裡的我。而且，我還希望能得到她的愛，雖然我知道這是不可能的。
    我該怎麼告訴她呢？直接告訴她椅子裡面有人，她一定會嚇得直接跑出去，告訴她的丈夫和下人吧？這樣一來，我就沒辦法和她在一起了。
    所以我想，我要做的第一件事，就是要讓她覺得坐在我這把椅子上是非常舒服的。然後，她可能會愛上這把椅子。她是一位作家，應該會比普通人更能感受到周圍的東西。如果她能把這把椅子當成一件活物去喜愛，而不是只把它看作是一把椅子，只要她能這樣，我就很滿意了。
    為了讓她喜歡上這把椅子，每次她坐下來的時候，我總是輕輕地去接住她；當她覺得累的時候，我會輕輕地動一動大腿，讓她坐得更舒服……

sentences.simplified: 几天后，拍卖会开始了。
sentences.traditional: 幾天後，拍賣會開始了。
sentences.pinyin: jǐ tiān hòu pāi mài huì kāi shǐ le
sentences.english: A few days later, the auction started.

sentences.simplified: 我的椅子很快被买走了。
sentences.traditional: 我的椅子很快被買走了。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ de yǐ zi hěn kuài bèi mǎi zǒu le
sentences.english: My chair was sold very quickly.

sentences.simplified: 买家是一个市里的名人，他的家离这儿只有几公里的路。
sentences.traditional: 買家是一個市裡的名人，他的家離這兒只有幾公里的路。
sentences.pinyin: mǎi jiā shì yí ge shì lǐ de míng rén tā de jiā lí zhè‘r zhǐ yǒu jǐ gōng lǐ de lù
sentences.english: The buyer was a famous person in the city. His house was only a few kilometers away.

sentences.simplified: 一路上，卡车左转右转，我在椅子里特别难受。
sentences.traditional: 一路上，卡車左轉右轉，我在椅子裡特別難受。
sentences.pinyin: yí lù shang kǎ chē zuǒ zhuǎn yòu zhuǎn wǒ zài yǐ zi lǐ tè bié nán shòu
sentences.english: On the road, the truck swayed left and right, and I felt particularly uncomfortable in the chair.

sentences.simplified: 但一想到买家不是外国人，而是中国人，和我希望的一样，我就特别的高兴！
sentences.traditional: 但一想到買家不是外國人，而是中國人，和我希望的一樣，我就特別的高興！
sentences.pinyin: dàn yì xiǎng dào mǎi jiā bú shì wài guó rén ér shì zhōng guó rén hé wǒ xī wàng de yí yàng wǒ jiù tè bié de gāo xìng
sentences.english: But as soon as I remembered that the buyer was not a foreigner but Chinese, just as I had hoped, I would be particularly happy!

sentences.simplified: 买家住在一个豪华的大房子里。
sentences.traditional: 買家住在一個豪華的大房子裡。
sentences.pinyin: mǎi jiā zhù zài yí ge háo huá de dà fáng zi lǐ
sentences.english: The buyer lived in a big and luxurious house.

sentences.simplified: 我的椅子被放在那个大房子的书房里。
sentences.traditional: 我的椅子被放在那個大房子的書房裡。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ de yǐ zi bèi fàng zài nà ge dà fáng zi de shū fáng lǐ
sentences.english: My chair was placed in the study of that big house.

sentences.simplified: 最让我满意的是，比起男主人，更多的是他年轻漂亮的妻子使用这个书房。
sentences.traditional: 最讓我滿意的是，比起男主人，更多的是他年輕漂亮的妻子使用這個書房。
sentences.pinyin: zuì ràng wǒ mǎn yì de shì bǐ qǐ nán zhǔ rén gèng duō de shì tā nián qīng piào liang de qī zi shǐ yòng zhè ge shū fáng
sentences.english: Compared to the man of the house, I was more pleased that his young and beautiful wife used this study.

sentences.simplified: 之后的一个月，我常常和这位女主人在一起。
sentences.traditional: 之後的一個月，我常常和這位女主人在一起。
sentences.pinyin: zhī hòu de yí ge yuè wǒ cháng cháng hé zhè wèi nǚ zhǔ rén zài yì qǐ
sentences.english: Over the next month, I was often together with the lady of the house.

sentences.simplified: 除了吃饭、睡觉的时间外，女主人小小的身体总是坐在我的腿上。
sentences.traditional: 除了吃飯、睡覺的時間外，女主人小小的身體總是坐在我的腿上。
sentences.pinyin: chú le chī fàn shuì jiào de shí jiān wài nǚ zhǔ rén xiǎo xiǎo de shēn tǐ zǒng shì zuò zài wǒ de tuǐ shang
sentences.english: Aside from when she was eating or sleeping, the small body of the lady of the house would always be sitting on my leg.

sentences.simplified: 因为这段时间，女主人总是把自己关在书房里写小说。
sentences.traditional: 因為這段時間，女主人總是把自己關在書房裡寫小說。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi zhè duàn shí jiān nǚ zhǔ rén zǒng shì bǎ zì jǐ guān zài shū fáng lǐ xiě xiǎo shuō
sentences.english: Because at that time, the lady of the house would always lock herself in the study to write her novel.

sentences.simplified: 我有多么地爱她，应该不用我在信里多讲了吧？
sentences.traditional: 我有多麼地愛她，應該不用我在信裡多講了吧？
sentences.pinyin: wǒ yǒu duō me de ài tā yīng gāi bú yòng wǒ zài xìn lǐ duō jiǎng le ba
sentences.english: I don’t think I need to tell you here how much I loved her.

sentences.simplified: 她是我接触到的第一个中国女人，而且有着非常美丽的身体。
sentences.traditional: 她是我接觸到的第一個中國女人，而且有著非常美麗的身體。
sentences.pinyin: tā shì wǒ jiē chù dào de dì yī ge zhōng guó nǚ rén ér qiě yǒu zhe fēi cháng měi lì de shēn tǐ
sentences.english: She was the first Chinese woman I had got close to, and she also had an extremely beautiful body.

sentences.simplified: 我在这里第一次感受到了真正的爱情，
sentences.traditional: 我在這裡第一次感受到了真正的愛情，
sentences.pinyin: wǒ zài zhè lǐ dì yī cì gǎn shòu dào le zhēn zhèng de ài qíng
sentences.english: There, I experienced real love for the first time.

sentences.simplified: 之前的“恋爱对象”完全不能和她相比。
sentences.traditional: 之前的“戀愛對象”完全不能和她相比。
sentences.pinyin: zhī qián de liàn ài duì xiàng wán quán bù néng hé tā xiāng bǐ
sentences.english: The “objects of my love” from the past could not compare with her at all.

sentences.simplified: 我为什么这么说呢？
sentences.traditional: 我為什麼這麼說呢？
sentences.pinyin: wǒ wèi shén me zhè me shuō ne
sentences.english: Why do I say this?

sentences.simplified: 因为我只有对她有了以前从来没有过的感觉。
sentences.traditional: 因為我只有對她有了以前從來沒有過的感覺。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi wǒ zhǐ yǒu duì tā yǒu le yǐ qián cóng lái méi yǒu guò de gǎn jué
sentences.english: Because I felt something towards her which I had never experienced before.

sentences.simplified: 我不满足于只是偷偷地看着她，偷偷地接触她，
sentences.traditional: 我不滿足於只是偷偷地看著她，偷偷地接觸她，
sentences.pinyin: wǒ bù mǎn zú yú zhǐ shì tōu tōu de kàn zhe tā tōu tōu de jiē chù tā
sentences.english: I was not satisfied by just sneakily looking at her or sneakily touching her.

sentences.simplified: 我还想让她知道我这个人，让她知道有我在她身边。
sentences.traditional: 我還想讓她知道我這個人，讓她知道有我在她身邊。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ hái xiǎng ràng tā zhī dào wǒ zhè ge rén ràng tā zhī dào yǒu wǒ zài tā shēn biān
sentences.english: I also wanted to let her know about me and let her know that I was by her side.

sentences.simplified: 可能的话，我希望她能意识到椅子里的我。
sentences.traditional: 可能的話，我希望她能意識到椅子裡的我。
sentences.pinyin: kě néng de huà wǒ xī wàng tā néng yì shí dào yǐ zi lǐ de wǒ
sentences.english: If possible, I hoped that she would also become aware of me inside the chair.

sentences.simplified: 而且，我还希望能得到她的爱，虽然我知道这是不可能的。
sentences.traditional: 而且，我還希望能得到她的愛，雖然我知道這是不可能的。
sentences.pinyin: ér qiě wǒ hái xī wàng néng dé dào tā de ài suī rán wǒ zhī dào zhè shì bù kě néng de
sentences.english: And, I also hoped that I could win her love, even though I knew that it was impossible.

sentences.simplified: 我该怎么告诉她呢？
sentences.traditional: 我該怎麼告訴她呢？
sentences.pinyin: wǒ gāi zěn me gào su tā ne
sentences.english: How should I tell her?

sentences.simplified: 直接告诉她椅子里面有人，
sentences.traditional: 直接告訴她椅子裡面有人，
sentences.pinyin: zhí jiē gào su tā yǐ zi lǐ miàn yǒu rén
sentences.english: If I I told her directly that a person was in the chair, ..

sentences.simplified: 她一定会吓得直接跑出去，告诉她的丈夫和下人吧？
sentences.traditional: 她一定會嚇得直接跑出去，告訴她的丈夫和下人吧？
sentences.pinyin: tā yí dìng huì xià de zhí jiē pǎo chū qù gào su tā de zhàng fu hé xià rén ba
sentences.english: .. she would surely be terrified and run out to tell her husband and servants?

sentences.simplified: 这样一来，我就没办法和她在一起了。
sentences.traditional: 這樣一來，我就沒辦法和她在一起了。
sentences.pinyin: zhè yàng yì lái wǒ jiù méi bàn fǎ hé tā zài yì qǐ le
sentences.english: In this way, I had no way of being with her.

sentences.simplified: 所以我想，我要做的第一件事，就是要让她觉得坐在我这把椅子上是非常舒服的。
sentences.traditional: 所以我想，我要做的第一件事，就是要讓她覺得坐在我這把椅子上是非常舒服的。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ wǒ xiǎng wǒ yào zuò de dì yī jiàn shì jiù shì yào ràng tā jué de zuò zài wǒ zhè bǎ yǐ zi shang shì fēi cháng shū fu de
sentences.english: So I thought, the first thing I need to do, is to make her feel that sitting on my chair is extremely comfortable.

sentences.simplified: 然后，她可能会爱上这把椅子。
sentences.traditional: 然後，她可能會愛上這把椅子。
sentences.pinyin: rán hòu tā kě néng huì ài shàng zhè bǎ yǐ zi
sentences.english: And then, she might come to love this chair.

sentences.simplified: 她是一位作家，应该会比普通人更能感受到周围的东西。
sentences.traditional: 她是一位作家，應該會比普通人更能感受到周圍的東西。
sentences.pinyin: tā shì yí wèi zuò jiā yīng gāi huì bǐ pǔ tōng rén gèng néng gǎn shòu dào zhōu wéi de dōng xi
sentences.english: She is an author, and is probably better able to feel  things around her than ordinary people.

sentences.simplified: 如果她能把这把椅子当成一件活物去喜爱，而不是只把它看作是一把椅子，
sentences.traditional: 如果她能把這把椅子當成一件活物去喜愛，而不是只把它看作是一把椅子，
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ tā néng bǎ zhè bǎ yǐ zi dàng chéng yí jiàn huó wù qù xǐ ài ér bú shì zhǐ bǎ tā kàn zuò shì yì bǎ yǐ zi
sentences.english: If she can think of the chair as an object to love, and not just a chair, ..

sentences.simplified: 只要她能这样，我就很满意了。
sentences.traditional: 只要她能這樣，我就很滿意了。
sentences.pinyin: zhǐ yào tā néng zhè yàng wǒ jiù hěn mǎn yì le
sentences.english: .. as long as she can do that, I will be very satisfied.

sentences.simplified: 为了让她喜欢上这把椅子，每次她坐下来的时候，我总是轻轻地去接住她；
sentences.traditional: 為了讓她喜歡上這把椅子，每次她坐下來的時候，我總是輕輕地去接住她；
sentences.pinyin: wèi le ràng tā xǐ huan shàng zhè bǎ yǐ zi měi cì tā zuò xia lai de shí hou wǒ zǒng shì qīng qīng de qù jiē zhù tā
sentences.english: In order to make her love this chair, every time she sat down, I would gently hold her.

sentences.simplified: 当她觉得累的时候，我会轻轻地动一动大腿，让她坐得更舒服……
sentences.traditional: 當她覺得累的時候，我會輕輕地動一動大腿，讓她坐得更舒服……
sentences.pinyin: dāng tā jué de lèi de shí hou wǒ huì qīng qīng de dòng yí dòng dà tuǐ ràng tā zuò de gèng shū fu
sentences.english: When she felt tired, I would gently move my thigh so she was sitting more comfortably.

sentence_translations: A few days later, the auction started.
My chair was sold very quickly.
The buyer was a famous person in the city. His house was only a few kilometers away.
On the road, the truck swayed left and right, and I felt particularly uncomfortable in the chair.
But as soon as I remembered that the buyer was not a foreigner but Chinese, just as I had hoped, I would be particularly happy!
The buyer lived in a big and luxurious house.
My chair was placed in the study of that big house.
Compared to the man of the house, I was more pleased that his young and beautiful wife used this study.
Over the next month, I was often together with the lady of the house.
Aside from when she was eating or sleeping, the small body of the lady of the house would always be sitting on my leg.
Because at that time, the lady of the house would always lock herself in the study to write her novel.
I don’t think I need to tell you here how much I loved her.
She was the first Chinese woman I had got close to, and she also had an extremely beautiful body.
There, I experienced real love for the first time.
The “objects of my love” from the past could not compare with her at all.
Why do I say this?
Because I felt something towards her which I had never experienced before.
I was not satisfied by just sneakily looking at her or sneakily touching her.
I also wanted to let her know about me and let her know that I was by her side.
If possible, I hoped that she would also become aware of me inside the chair.
And, I also hoped that I could win her love, even though I knew that it was impossible.
How should I tell her?
If I I told her directly that a person was in the chair, ..
.. she would surely be terrified and run out to tell her husband and servants?
In this way, I had no way of being with her.
So I thought, the first thing I need to do, is to make her feel that sitting on my chair is extremely comfortable.
And then, she might come to love this chair.
She is an author, and is probably better able to feel  things around her than ordinary people.
If she can think of the chair as an object to love, and not just a chair, ..
.. as long as she can do that, I will be very satisfied.
In order to make her love this chair, every time she sat down, I would gently hold her.
When she felt tired, I would gently move my thigh so she was sitting more comfortably.
